title: Saturated extensions: realizing all finite-parameter types

based_on.title: Lecture Notes: An Introduction to Model Theory

summary: Realize every type over the original finite parameter sets in one extension, then repeat to obtain an omega-saturated elementary extension without countability assumptions.
abstract: A collection of formulas can have a solution for every finite selection of its conditions while having no single solution in the original structure. An elementary extension can supply that missing point while preserving every statement about the old points. We show that one extension can answer all such requests over finite sets of original parameters at once. Its new points create further requests, so the construction is repeated along a countable chain. Every finite parameter set in the union belongs to a stage, and the following stage supplies its missing solutions. The resulting extension is omega-saturated: it realizes every compatible complete description of one point using finitely many parameters. This existence theorem applies to every nonempty structure; retaining countable size requires additional conditions.
